sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on hn volute casings.
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our contract requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110), so the change cannot take effect on the date you announce.
Your rolling on-time delivery to 2026Q3 stands at 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
In exchange for your commitment to 14-day payment terms and the binding volume of 8,150 pieces, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €133.50.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €133.50 per unit.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €134.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
As to the index change and volume change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.

The LCI-C data you cited matches our own figures, underscoring the unavoidable cost realities our foundry must cover.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to the volume of 8,150 pieces.
In response, we are prepared to lower our price to €135.70 for the package starting 1 April 2027 with 90-day payment terms.
We are getting closer, and I am confident we can reach an agreement that respects the realities of our foundry.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
